promotion: experimental_only; no held-out or Act 1 claim

audit.candidates: Distinct recorded played, target argmax, best visited Q, actor favorite and each new variant recommendation.
audit.continuation: Frozen greedy public policy. Completed hypothetical returns only; missing returns for cutoff/unsupported. Common sampled public-belief worlds per first action. Greedy continuations do not bound optimal values.
audit.interpretation: New analyses use a fixed independent planner seed, not the original per-episode RNG progression. Viewer opening additionally reruns original heavy settings with its original initial seed and verifies the recorded action/value/visit/target fields.
audit.selection: First completed win and loss when available per scenario, then prioritized disagreement or midpoint; viewer opening appended. Diagnostic stratification, not a representative frequency estimate.

confirmation.selection: Healthy variant with mean and p95 thinking <=5s, no control-win loss, strictly more challenge wins or equal wins with positive paired return CI lower bound. Rank by challenge wins, return, then lower mean latency. Freeze one candidate before confirmation.
confirmation.teacher_gate: Fresh development: strictly positive paired win CI lower bound, nonnegative paired return CI lower bound, no control-win loss, full coverage/no cutoff, mean and p95 <=5s. No automatic play-default or campaign promotion.

restrictions: No held-out test or native data
Public declarations and accepted prefixes only
No new training without fresh teacher gate
protocol.statistics: 10000 paired source-fight percentile bootstrap samples. One observation per case/scenario per controller. Conditional action-rollout uncertainty is separate from real-fight evaluation; development intervals are exploratory.
